entry.name: refreshMinutes
entry.label: Minutes between automatic refreshes

entry.name: showClaude
entry.label: Show the Claude Code limits

entry.name: claudeSource
entry.label: Where the Claude limits come from: claudecode (Claude Code asked for its usage, headless) or statusline (what Claude Code passes its status line); neither reads the login (an older value, endpoint, is read as claudecode)

entry.name: claudeCommand
entry.label: The Claude Code program for the claudecode source; empty means claude on the PATH (or ~/.local/bin/claude)

entry.name: credentialsPath
entry.label: Claude Code login file, only checked to exist (with none the provider is left out); empty means $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude

entry.name: showCodex
entry.label: Show the ChatGPT (Codex) limits

entry.name: codexAuthPath
entry.label: Codex login file, only checked to exist (with none the provider is left out); empty means $CODEX_HOME/auth.json or ~/.codex/auth.json

entry.name: codexCommand
entry.label: The Codex program, asked for its usage over its app server; empty means codex on the PATH (or ~/.local/bin/codex)

entry.name: hiddenRows
entry.label: Ids of the rows not shown (for example claude:weekly_scoped:Fable)

entry.name: rowOrder
entry.label: Ids of the rows in the order shown; rows not listed follow, each service's in the server's order

entry.name: knownRows
entry.label: Every row shown so far, as JSON, so the settings can offer it for hiding (written by the widget)

entry.name: placedAtDesignSize
entry.label: Set by the widget a moment after it is first shown on a desktop; from then on it asks for no more room than it has, so a size the user set is kept

entry.name: sizeMode
entry.label: fit: the content zooms with the widget's width; fixed: zoomPercent

entry.name: zoomPercent
entry.label: Zoom in percent when sizeMode is fixed

entry.name: overflowMode
entry.label: When the rows do not fit: scroll, grow (make the widget taller) or shrink (smaller text)

entry.name: staleMinutes
entry.label: Draw the numbers in staleColor when the last good answer is older than this; 0 means never

entry.name: staleColor
entry.label: Colour of numbers older than staleMinutes (yellow, apart from the warning orange and critical red)

entry.name: warnPercent
entry.label: A percentage from this value up is drawn in the warning colour; 0 means never

entry.name: criticalPercent
entry.label: A percentage from this value up is drawn in the critical colour; 0 means never

entry.name: warnColor
entry.label: Colour of a percentage from warnPercent up

entry.name: criticalColor
entry.label: Colour of a percentage from criticalPercent up
